SeekBarPreference.android:title: Confidence Thresholds
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Minimum confidence in percent. Below it, no transmitter box or orientation triangle is shown.

ListPreference.android:title: PyTorch CPU threads
ListPreference.android:summary: %s used by the embedded PyTorch runtime

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Transmitter Detection Model
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: Finds the transmitter (the central pyramid) and draws its box.

CheckBoxPreference.android:title: Orientation Detection Model
CheckBoxPreference.android:summary: Names the direction the pyramid is seen from and draws a triangle. With both ticked it runs after a transmitter is found, inside its box; ticked alone it runs on every frame. Slower: 640 × 640 input.

Preference.android:title: In-Device Local File Inference
Preference.android:summary: Open a test image from this phone and run the ticked models on it.
